profile.summary: Software Engineer on Cisco's IoT Team.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Working with IoT team on tool for defining JSON transforms.

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description: Provide individualized assistance to middle school students, including working through home work problems and creating extra practice problems to help understand concepts and perfect skills.

positions.title: Solutions Team Intern
positions.description: Refactoring Python code in Django framework for global innovation consultancy.

positions.title: Residential Counselor
positions.description: Teaching assistant and counselor at Stanford’s residential summer programs for high school students: SAILORS (Stanford Artificial Intelligence Laboratory's Outreach Summer) and International Institutes (Sessions II and III). Supported academic projects, supervised activities and field trips.

positions.title: Environmental Studies and Planning Intern
positions.description: Paid position using Jupyter Notebook to analyze survey data from communities in Indonesia in order to facilitate efficient expansion of electricity access.

volunteerExperiences.description: For my Gold Award Project, I designed and ran a two month after school program at Kid Street Learning Center. I taught 24 middle school students the basics of computer programming using the Scratch programming environment, as well as raising funds for and purchasing 6 i-Pads to donate to the after school program.  My work was specifically aimed at inspiring and educating students from under-represented backgrounds in Computer Science.

organizations.name: 350.org
organizations.description: I am passionate about climate action and renewable energy.  Throughout high school, I frequently participated in 350 events, including creating materials for and attending protests, and climbing Half Dome with a group of school friends to raise awareness.
